title: Custom Kit Design Studio
content:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Service",
  "name": "MOMUTO Custom Kit Design Studio",
  "description": "Senior designer assigned to your project. Custom soccer kit mockup in 24-48h, unlimited revisions. $15 design deposit, fully refunded on orders of 5+ jerseys.",
  "brand": { "@type": "Brand", "name": "MOMUTO" },
  "offers": {
    "@type": "Offer",
    "price": "15.00",
    "priceCurrency": "USD",
    "description": "Design deposit — fully refunded on orders of 5+ jerseys",
    "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock",
    "priceValidUntil": "2026-12-31"
  },
  "provider": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "MOMUTO", "url": "/" }
}
</script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css" />
<style>
    :root {
        --bg-primary: #0a0a0a; --bg-panel: #111; --bg-card: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
        --text-white: #f5f5f5; --text-muted: #a1a1aa; --text-dim: #71717a;
        --accent-red: #c8352e; --accent-red-hover: #e04038;
        --border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --border-hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
        --font-display: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; --font-body: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
    }

    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { background-color: #0a0a0a !important; color: #f5f5f5 !important; }
    .title { display: none; }
    .page-template-request-design .container_wrapper { margin: 0 !important; max-width: 100% !important; width: 100% !important; }
    body { font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--text-white); background: var(--bg-primary); line-height: 1.6; }

    header.hero.full-bleed { left: auto !important; transform: none !important; width: 100% !important; margin: 0 auto !important; position: relative; padding: 6rem 20px 4rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; background: transparent; border: none; overflow: visible !important; }
    header.hero.full-bleed::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 100vw; background: var(--bg-panel); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); z-index: -1; }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 100%; max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .hero h1 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.95; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text-white); }
    .hero h1 .highlight { color: var(--text-white); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent-red); text-decoration-thickness: 4px; text-underline-offset: 8px; }
    .hero h3 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0 auto; max-width: 700px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .hero-intro { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-dim); max-width: 700px; margin: 1.5rem auto 0; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center; padding: 0; }
    .hero-intro strong { color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; }
    .mo-editor-reset .hero-intro { display: block; margin-inline-start: auto; margin-inline-end: auto; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
    .social-proof-strip { background: var(--bg-panel); padding: 3rem 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .proof-container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .proof-stats { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 4rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .stat-number { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 3rem; color: var(--text-white); display: block; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
    .stat-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }
    .proof-teams { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .proof-team { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
    .path-section { padding: 6rem 20px; background: var(--bg-primary); }
    .path-container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .path-header { margin-bottom: 4rem; }
    .path-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .path-header p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.6; }
    .path-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
    .path-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 2.5rem 2rem; text-align: center; transition: all 0.3s ease; }
    .path-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .path-icon { font-size: 2rem; color: var(--accent-red); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .path-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-white); letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
    .path-for { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .path-description { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    .path-cta { font-family: var(--font-body); background: transparent; color: var(--text-white); padding: 14px 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; font-size: 0.78rem; }
    .path-cta:hover { background: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .path-cta-primary { background: var(--accent-red) !important; border-color: var(--accent-red) !important; color: #fff !important; }
    .path-cta-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-red-hover) !important; border-color: var(--accent-red-hover) !important; }
    .comparison-section { margin-top: 3rem; padding-top: 3rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); text-align: center; }
    .comparison-section h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 2rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .comparison-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
    .comparison-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 2rem 1.5rem; text-align: left; }
    .comparison-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--accent-red); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .comparison-option { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .comparison-best-for { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .comparison-benefit { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55; }
    .action-teaser { background: var(--bg-panel); padding: 4rem 20px; }
    .teaser-container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .teaser-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
    .teaser-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .teaser-header p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .action-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
    .action-preview { aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; position: relative; cursor: pointer; }
    .action-preview img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.3s ease; }
    .action-preview:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
    .action-overlay { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.85)); color: white; padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
    .action-preview:hover .action-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .team-name { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
    .team-location { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 300; opacity: 0.7; }
    .view-gallery-btn { font-family: var(--font-body); background: transparent; color: var(--text-white); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.78rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; }
    .view-gallery-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); color: #fff; }
    .why-section { padding: 6rem 20px; background: var(--bg-primary); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .why-container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .why-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .why-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .why-header p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.6; }
    .why-header p a { color: var(--text-white); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent-red); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
    .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-top: 3.5rem; }
    .why-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 2rem 1.75rem; }
    .why-card-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--accent-red); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .why-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-white); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .why-card p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; }
    .why-card p a { color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
    .why-card p a:hover { color: var(--accent-red); }
    .how-it-works-section { padding: 5rem 20px; background: var(--bg-primary); }
    .hiw-container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .hiw-container h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 3rem; color: var(--text-white); text-align: center; }
    .hiw-steps { list-style: none; }
    .hiw-steps li { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 2rem; padding-bottom: 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .hiw-steps li:last-child { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
    .hiw-num { flex-shrink: 0; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--accent-red); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .hiw-steps li > div strong { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .hiw-steps li > div p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }
    .hiw-steps li > div p a { color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }
    .hiw-internal-links { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-dim); text-align: center; line-height: 2; }
    .hiw-internal-links a { color: var(--text-white); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent-red); }
    .faq-section { padding: 5rem 20px; background: var(--bg-panel); }
    .faq-container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .faq-container h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 3rem; color: var(--text-white); text-align: center; }
    .faq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 1.75rem 0; }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .faq-item h3 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-white); margin-bottom: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; }
    .faq-item p { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; }
    .faq-item a { color: var(--text-white); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent-red); }
    .form-section { padding: 6rem 20px; background: var(--bg-primary); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .form-container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .form-content { background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 4rem; color: white; position: relative; }
    .form-intro { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 2rem; }
    .form-intro h2 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-white); }
    .form-intro p { font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; }
    .form-intro p a { color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }
    .progress-indicator { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 40px; margin-bottom: 50px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 30px; }
    .progress-step { text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim); cursor: default; }
    .progress-step.active { color: var(--text-white); }
    .step-label { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); width: 28px; height: 28px; line-height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .progress-step.active .step-label { background: var(--text-white); color: var(--bg-primary); border-color: var(--text-white); }
    .step-text { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-weight: 600; }
    .form-step { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease; }
    .form-step.active { display: block; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from {opacity:0; transform: translateY(10px);} to {opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }
    .form-section-inner { margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .form-section-inner h3, .form-section-inner h4 { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--text-white); }
    .input-group { margin-bottom: 25px; }
    .input-group input, .input-group select { width: 100%; padding: 16px 18px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: var(--text-white); font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 400; transition: all 0.3s ease; }
    .input-group input:focus, .input-group select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--text-white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
    .input-group input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .custom-file-upload label { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: var(--text-white); padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.78rem; transition: all 0.3s; }
    .custom-file-upload input[type="file"] { display: none; }
    .custom-file-upload label:hover { border-color: var(--text-white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
    #fileNameDisplay { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--accent-red); font-weight: 500; }
    .colors-row { display: flex; gap: 40px; margin-top: 20px; }
    .color-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .color-col label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; }
    .color-circle { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; }
    .color-circle:hover { transform: scale(1.1); border-color: var(--text-white); }
    .style-scale { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; margin: 30px 0; }
    .style-scale span { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--text-white); flex-shrink: 0; }
    input[type="range"] { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: none; }
    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; background: var(--accent-red); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; border: none; }
    .style-extremes { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; }
    .extreme { text-align: center; width: 48%; }
    .extreme img { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); opacity: 0.8; }
    .extreme p { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .size-slider { position: relative; padding: 30px 0; margin: 10px 0 20px; }
    .size-track { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .size-options { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; position: relative; }
    .size-option { position: relative; text-align: center; width: 20%; }
    .size-radio { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
    .size-button { display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--bg-panel); border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin: 0 auto 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
    .size-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; display: block; font-weight: 500; }
    .size-radio:checked + .size-label .size-button { background-color: var(--accent-red); border-color: var(--accent-red); transform: scale(1.4); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(200,53,46,0.3); }
    .size-radio:checked + .size-label { color: var(--text-white); font-weight: 700; }
    .form-navigation { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 50px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 30px; }
    .next-step, .submit-form { font-family: var(--font-body); background: var(--accent-red); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 16px 36px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.78rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; }
    .next-step:hover, .submit-form:hover { background: var(--accent-red-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .prev-step { font-family: var(--font-body); background: transparent; color: var(--text-white); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding: 16px 28px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 0.78rem; cursor: pointer; }
    .prev-step:hover { border-color: var(--text-white); }
    .terms-checkbox { display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); margin: 20px 0; }
    .terms-checkbox input[type="checkbox"] { appearance: auto !important; -webkit-appearance: checkbox !important; width: 20px !important; height: 20px !important; margin-right: 15px !important; cursor: pointer; accent-color: var(--accent-red) !important; opacity: 1 !important; position: static !important; display: block !important; }
    .terms-checkbox label { font-family: var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; margin: 0; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .terms-checkbox a { color: var(--text-white); text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 600; }
    #confirmationMessage { text-align: center; padding: 40px; color: var(--text-white); }
    .success-icon { color: #4ade80; font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .color-modal { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; z-index: 2000; background: transparent; transform: none; padding: 0; max-width: none; box-shadow: none; }
    .modal-overlay { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); z-index: 1; }
    .color-modal-content { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: var(--bg-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 30px; width: 90%; max-width: 400px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 2; }
    .color-modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .color-modal-header h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--text-white); letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

<script>
(function() {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var isPaid = params.get('paid') === 'true';

  if (isPaid) {
    // Show confirmation banner
    document.getElementById('paidBanner').style.display = 'block';
    // Hide payment gate, show form
    document.getElementById('payment-gate').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('brief-form-section').style.display = 'block';
    // Scroll to form smoothly after a short delay
    setTimeout(function() {
      document.getElementById('cta-form').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 300);
  }

  // Prefill Stripe email from gate input
  var gateEmail = document.getElementById('gateEmail');
  var gatePayBtn = document.getElementById('gatePayBtn');
  var baseStripeUrl = 'https://buy.stripe.com/00w8wP7I15qfepm2K7dEs1B';

  if (gateEmail && gatePayBtn) {
    gateEmail.addEventListener('input', function() {
      var email = this.value.trim();
      if (email) {
        gatePayBtn.href = baseStripeUrl + '?prefilled_email=' + encodeURIComponent(email);
      } else {
        gatePayBtn.href = baseStripeUrl;
      }
    });
  }

  // Smooth scroll for Studio path card CTA
  var studioCta = document.getElementById('studioPathCta');
  if (studioCta) {
    studioCta.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.getElementById('payment-gate').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
    let currentStep = 1;
    const totalSteps = 3;
    function showStep(step) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.form-step').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById(`step${step}`).classList.add('active');
        document.querySelectorAll('.progress-step').forEach((s, i) => { if(i + 1 <= step) { s.classList.add('active'); } else { s.classList.remove('active'); } });
    }
    function nextStep() { if (validateCurrentStep()) { if (currentStep < totalSteps) { currentStep++; showStep(currentStep); document.getElementById('cta-form').scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'}); } } }
    function prevStep() { if (currentStep > 1) { currentStep--; showStep(currentStep); } }
    function validateCurrentStep() {
        const currentStepElement = document.getElementById(`step${currentStep}`);
        const requiredFields = currentStepElement.querySelectorAll('input[required], select[required]');
        for (let field of requiredFields) {
            if (!field.value.trim() && field.type !== 'checkbox') { field.focus(); field.style.borderColor = '#e2214b'; return false; }
            if (field.type === 'checkbox' && !field.checked) { field.parentElement.style.borderColor = '#e2214b'; return false; }
        }
        if (currentStep === 2) {
            const crest = document.getElementById('clubCrest');
            if (!crest || !crest.files || crest.files.length === 0) {
                const label = document.querySelector('label[for="clubCrest"]');
                if (label) label.style.outline = '2px solid #e2214b';
                const err = document.getElementById('crestError');
                if (err) err.style.display = 'block';
                crest && crest.parentElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.next-step').forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', nextStep); });
        document.querySelectorAll('.prev-step').forEach(btn => { btn.addEventListener('click', prevStep); });
        document.getElementById('proposalForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) { if (!validateCurrentStep()) { e.preventDefault(); return; } });
        document.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(input => { input.addEventListener('input', function() { this.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)'; }); });
        document.querySelector('a[href="#cta-form"]').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); document.getElementById('cta-form').scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth'}); });
    });
    function previewLogo(input) {
        const preview = document.getElementById('logoPreview');
        const nameDisplay = document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay');
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            nameDisplay.textContent = input.files[0].name;
            reader.onload = function(e) { preview.innerHTML = `<img src="${e.target.result}" style="width:100%; border-radius:4px;">`; };
            reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
            const label = document.querySelector('label[for="clubCrest"]');
            if (label) label.style.outline = '';
            const err = document.getElementById('crestError');
            if (err) err.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }
    function previewDesign(input) {
        const preview = document.getElementById('designPreview');
        const nameDisplay = document.getElementById('designNameDisplay');
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            nameDisplay.textContent = input.files[0].name;
            reader.onload = function(e) { preview.innerHTML = '<img src="' + e.target.result + '" style="width:100%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">'; };
            reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
        }
    }
    const colors = ['#FF0000','#00FF00','#0000FF','#FFFF00','#FF00FF','#00FFFF','#800000','#008000','#000080','#808000','#800080','#008080','#FFA500','#FFC0CB','#A52A2A','#808080','#000000','#FFFFFF','#E2214B','#0055FF','#FF29CC','#32CD32','#FF6347','#4169E1'];
    let currentColorTarget = '';
    function openColorModal(target) {
        currentColorTarget = target;
        const modal = document.getElementById('colorModal');
        const swatches = document.getElementById('colorSwatches');
        swatches.innerHTML = '';
        colors.forEach(color => {
            const swatch = document.createElement('div');
            swatch.className = 'color-swatch';
            swatch.style.backgroundColor = color;
            if(color === '#FFFFFF') swatch.style.border = '1px solid #ccc';
            swatch.onclick = () => selectColor(color);
            swatches.appendChild(swatch);
        });
        modal.style.display = 'block';
    }
    function closeColorModal() { document.getElementById('colorModal').style.display = 'none'; }
    function selectColor(color) {
        document.getElementById(`${currentColorTarget}ColorCircle`).style.backgroundColor = color;
        document.getElementById(`${currentColorTarget}ColorValue`).value = color;
        closeColorModal();
    }
</script>
